sources.publisher: UC San Diego Academic Senate / proposed Department of Biomedical Informatics
sources.reviewScope: Visually inspected the complete page and extracted native image. The image combines a building photograph with a partial fifth-floor office-wing plan; the actual plan occupies only approximately 300 by 215 pixels. This is a partial source assessment, not a review of all 168 pages.
limitations: The Floor 05 title is readable, but the target label 5A03 is not reliably legible in the original embedded pixels.
A large conference-room outline and smaller offices are visible. Their room identity is not established by the number of conference rooms or by nearby text.
The 3312 sq ft allocation described in adjacent prose is departmental space, not the area of 5A03 or a floor-scale calibration.
The picture does not provide the complete lab-wing floor footprint.
sources.decision: Do not assign the visible conference room to 5A03 without an explicit source crosswalk; do not trace the picture into a current classroom geometry.

sources.reviewScope: Visually inspected the full native drawing. Readable sample labels include conference rooms 3A03 and 3A04 and laboratories with 32xx labels. These establish a third-level plan; no matching room labels for the current four target keys were found.
limitations: The 2025 URL upload path is not a drawing revision date.
No dimension string, scale bar, north arrow or drawing title block establishing a current as-built revision is supplied.
Wall geometry on this third-level drawing must not be copied to floors 1, 4 or 5A.
sources.decision: Retain the acquired source for possible future third-floor work; no current schedule room is modeled.

publicIdentityEvidence.finding: Official lab website identifies Israni Biomedical Research Facility as formerly BRF2.
Official directions place the Division of Biomedical Informatics on floor 5A. This is floor identity evidence, not a room perimeter.
The acquired HTML is a campus building viewer, with Israni Biomedical Research Facility (903) and Bldg-903-Off. It supplies bkey 903 but has no 5A03 string or classroom room-ID table.

runtimeDecision.reason: The public fourth-floor HTML adds exact vector room 4103. Original event-organizer pages explicitly place 1104 on L1 and 5A03 on L5; these levels retain empty outlines and unplaced listings only. 1102 remains knownUnmapped. Architect/proposal images still do not establish missing room perimeters.

publicVectorImport.scope: 126 of 127 published fourth-floor space polygons converted (107 room objects and 19 shared/unknown areas). Classroom 4103 is an exact room-ID/label match. Public corridor 87238 self-intersects and is excluded; no complete exterior slab is asserted.
